ctx.x: Red Clark, yeah. Mm-hmm. How did Pryju rank in the old days? Was he considered one of the best ones?

Oh yeah, he was, he had a, say, a cranny like a pipe. Yeah, he still has a little. He had that cranny like a pipe. Yeah, he used to play that drum. Yeah, he used to play. He could play too. Yeah. And him and Louis was good friends. They used to play each other, help each other out around, around Pete Lyle was around there when he was playing there with Marie and Arthur and Benville. Marie and Ben, I was there. I was there. I was there with Marie. I think it is. Over there with Benville.
Yeah, I think that's right. I was there with Benville.
